sent_subject: Three fixes for your FlexTown launch page
sent:
Liam —

Looked at flextownfitness.example and /join. Here are three changes we’d make for a launch page that turns paid clicks into same‑day sign‑ups.

1) Make the first screen do all the work
- One promise: “Join for £1. Instant email. Access card in 5 minutes.” Put this where “Join for £1” sits now; keep it literal.
- One action: “Start in 60 seconds”. Kill global nav and secondary CTAs on the campaign page (no top nav, no 7‑day pass). Keep a faint “Prefer a tour?” below the fold.
- Location first, inline: postcode field + club select in the hero, then the button.

2) Resolve price and fees before the form
- After club select, show “Pay today: £1 + joining fee £0/£15 (this club)” — no surprises at payment.
- Preselect the plan that matches the ad (e.g. Anytime). Hide the others on this page; upsells (sauna/PT) come after payment or in the welcome email.

3) Tighten the flow and proof
- Order: Club → Plan & Today’s total → Details → Card. Add a 3‑step progress bar (“Choose club • Plan • Pay”).
- Pull your best local proof into the first screen: 2–3 reviews from that club only, not generic.
- Right by the button: “Staffed now: collect card in 5 minutes” or “Collect from 9am”; if you can’t make it live, state the rule clearly.

A bare‑bones first screen
--------------------------------------------------
Join for £1 — [Nearest Club]
No contract. Instant confirmation by email. Access card ready in 5 minutes during staffed hours.
[Postcode]  [Club dropdown]
[Start in 60 seconds]
Small print: “Pay today: £1 + joining fee £0/£15 (this club). Cancel any time.”
Tiny link (muted): Prefer a tour?
Local reviews (2–3, short)
--------------------------------------------------

Why this matters for you: your /join flow is already fast; the campaign page should match it and remove every detour, with price certainty up front. That’s what stops drop‑off between click and card.

If you want, I’ll turn this into a one‑pager you can hand to your developer.

Fieldwork Studio
